scenario: Comments are non-semantic per LLEX.4.2 — the parser produces the same AST whether comments are present or absent. Pin: a rule with trailing `#` comments on its `where` and action lines compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: one compile cannot compare its lowering with the uncommented rule's.
